If Neeko is in your deck, choose 3 different legends in addition to your starting legend. (Different means none match names.)
When you play me, choose one of those legends and add it to your Legend Zone while I'm on the board.
RAD-167/167.review_note: Neeko requires three distinct extra legend names outside starting legend at deck validation; game setup records selections; her play trigger chooses one and adds it to the Legend Zone only while she remains on board. Added legends fire normal legend/phase triggers, are readied each turn, and are removed immediately when granting Neeko leaves; a delayed play trigger cannot create an orphan grant. Six engine-path tests passed in targeted CI 45161618284 (15/15 combined). Full regression still required.
